title: Supreme Court seeks CBSE response to plea seeking compartment exams for class XII students in Gulf countries
description: The Supreme Court on Wednesday sought the responses of the Union government and the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) on a plea seeking an opportunity for class XII students in Gulf and West Asian countries to appear in compartment examinations after this year’s board examinations were disrupted by the regional conflict due to the US-Iran war.
